info.name: Banking Backend API v2
info.description: Backend banking simulator. Run npm run seed first, then run only the Backend walkthrough folder for the repeatable API demo. Other folders are an endpoint catalog. Requests use explicit bearer headers and disable cookie handling. All amounts are integer paise. Administrator funding represents simulator money.

item.name: Backend walkthrough
item.description: Run this folder in order against seeded development data. It logs in sample users, funds Alice once for this run, transfers, replays, rejects a changed payload, inspects journals, reconciles, then logs out. The other folders are an endpoint catalog for individual requests; do not run the entire collection as a workflow.

exec: const accounts = pm.response.json().data?.accounts; const account = accounts?.find(a => a.accountType === "SAVINGS"); if (account) { pm.collectionVariables.set("accountId", account._id); pm.collectionVariables.set("senderAccountId", account._id); }

const account = pm.response.json().data?.accounts?.[0]; if (account) { pm.collectionVariables.set("toAccountId", account._id); pm.collectionVariables.set("recipientAccountNumber", account.accountNumber); }

exec: pm.test("Same transaction and no second payment", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.isIdempotentReplay).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data.transactionId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("transactionId")); });
